newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test. Inquiry moderate, demand fair.
Wk to date - 76,600 last week - 83,200 last year - 87,600
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lb

dressed basis 102.50. Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 62.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 102.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1150 lb heifers with end heiferettes 101.50.

Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and 400 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 76,600 head confirmed including 20,800 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
